channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: Open-air 'mall parks' are on the rise in SoCal — and exhausted parents are loving it
item.description: With the rise of e-commerce, it’s no secret that retail developers have had to get creative to keep attracting customers. One method? Making green turf and other kid-friendly spaces a mall centerpiece.

item.title: Captain's conviction upheld in Conception dive boat tragedy that killed 34
item.description: Captain in dive boat tragedy that resulted in 34 dead, fails in an appeal of a seaman's manslaughter conviction, and must serve four years

item.title: Ex-‘GMA’ host Joan Lunden alleges former WABC boss sexually harassed her
item.description: In her new memoir, former 'Good Morning America' host Joan Lunden alleges her boss at WABC sexually harassed her, then punished her when she denied his advances.

item.title: Paramount credit downgraded to 'junk' status over debt worries
item.description: S&P and Fitch Ratings are cool to the $79 billion in proposed Paramount-Warner Bros. debt.

item.title: Against the odds: Inside the struggle to keep Mt. Baldy's ski resort open
item.description: These days, managing a small ski business is like trying to keep a mom-and-pop general store afloat after Walmart comes to town.

item.title: Israel believes Iran war could last months, testing U.S. resolve
item.description: The prospect of extended combat creates novel political risks and uncertainties for President Trump.

item.title: What the Supreme Court ruling on gender identity means for students, parents, and schools
item.description: The Supreme Court lifts stay on lower court ruling, which means parents can demand to know about their child's gender issues without the child's consent.

item.title: Sen. Padilla preps for Trump trying to seize control of elections via emergency order
item.description: Padilla sent a letter to his Senate colleagues saying that any election takeover order by Trump would be 'wildly illegal and unconstitutional.'

item.title: Who is running for California governor in 2026? Meet the candidates
item.description: The wide-open race to succeed Gavin Newsom as California governor has attracted a large and diverse field of candidates.

item.title: Struggling Democrats need to drop out of California’s crowded governor race or risk a GOP win, party leader warns
item.description: A big field of candidates makes it possible for a Republican to be elected governor. California's Democratic Party leader told unviable candidates to bow out.
